description: This source file implements a dummy DCTDecode filter class for PDF processing in the PDFsharp library. The class allows reading and writing PDF files with DCT encoded streams, but the methods are currently not implemented and simply return copies of the input data.

classes.name: DctDecode
classes.description: A dummy implementation of a DCTDecode filter for PDF streams that currently does nothing but inherit from NoOpFiler.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Overrides the Encode method to log an informational message and return the input data as-is.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Overrides the Decode method to log an informational message and return the input data as-is.
